decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 11 links on this page open a file — 8 Video, 3 PDF — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Drop the dash once the link is set apart
decisions.why: 1 of those items separate the link from its description with a dash. The link is now set in the display face at a larger size with a chevron after it, so the dash marks a boundary that is already unmistakable. Only the separator is removed — no word changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 1 list item opens with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Size an image by its shape
decisions.why: "Grants4ME Logo" measures 1000×1000 — it was sitting in the flow at its own pixel size, aligned with nothing.

decisions.label: Put the page’s one action in the banner
decisions.why: This page opens with a paragraph holding nothing but "Log In to Grants4ME" — the first thing it asks you to do, set as a line of body text. The banner has a place for exactly that, so it moves there as a button. The link and its words are unchanged; only where it sits changes.

decisions.label: Stop a picture floating with nothing beside it
decisions.why: 1 picture is set to float so text runs up beside it, but what follows it is a grid, a card or a table — a box, which clears the float rather than wrapping. So the picture sits alone with a column of white to its right and everything below starts past the bottom of it. Unfloated it is a picture in the flow, which is what it already looked like.
